scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test tests/*.test.mjs core/tests/*.test.mjs ports/*/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:generated: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- ports/vscode/themes ports/zed/themes ports/neovim/colors ports/neovim/lua/noctis2/generated
scripts.test:languages:neovim: npm run build && node tooling/validate-native-languages.mjs neovim
scripts.test:languages:zed: npm run build && node tooling/validate-native-languages.mjs zed
scripts.test:languages:tinymist: npm run build && node tooling/validate-native-languages.mjs tinymist
